name: Nestling
lore: At first light, Nestling scouts the floating sanctuaries and guides young guardians home.

name: Leafpaw
lore: Leafpaw follows waterfall paths, leaving a trail of fresh leaves for lost friends.

name: Emberkit
lore: Emberkit races between warm lava stones, carrying sparks to cold mountain nests.

name: Rippleo
lore: Rippleo listens to waterfalls and follows their echoes through the reef valleys.

name: Pebblit
lore: Pebblit shields small travelers beneath its sun-warmed stone plates.

name: Zephy
lore: Zephy brings fair winds and messages between the sky cities of the Volt guardians.

name: Lumibug
lore: Lumibug lights moonlit paths for quiet creatures without disturbing their dreams.

name: Thorncap
lore: Thorncap shelters tender seedlings beneath its layered woodland canopy.

name: Kiln Salamander
lore: Kiln Salamander knows every safe crossing through the lava caverns.

name: Copper Quail
lore: Copper Quail stands guard at the edge of the Crimson Forest.

name: Basalt Armadillo
lore: Basalt Armadillo builds sheltered trails where the mountain is hottest.
